blocks.intro: Outlines for the first three technical notes. Each is drafted by an Aquemi engineer and reviewed before publication.

items.t: What changed when Ph. Eur. accepted membrane WFI
items.d: Answer: since April 2017, Ph. Eur. 0169 allows WFI by a purification process equivalent to distillation, such as RO coupled with EDI or ultrafiltration. Sections: the old and new wording; the EMA questions and answers; what inspectors look for (sanitization, monitoring, biofilm control); when distillation is still the better choice; [Aquemi engineer] view.

items.t: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) and your water system
items.d: Answer: Annex 1 sets explicit expectations for WFI generation, storage, distribution and continuous monitoring. Sections: the clauses on water and steam; continuous TOC and conductivity monitoring; biofilm and sanitization; Pure Steam quality; a checklist for an existing system; [date of review].

items.t: Hot water or ozone: choosing a sanitization method for a PW loop
items.d: Answer: hot water sanitization at 80 °C needs no chemicals but uses energy and needs rated components; ozone runs at ambient temperature and needs UV destruction before use. Sections: how each works; materials and temperature limits; energy and cycle time [figures]; validation of ozone removal; how to choose.
